correctness.rationale: Uses the explicitly read Liu Theorem 5.3 formula for all a>p. For residue 0 all delta=p-1. For every proper q|p, q=1 gives I_p(1)=ceil((p-1)/2)<p-1 for composite p; for q>=2 the delta values are q-1,2q-1,...,p-1 and periodic in i with t=p/q; select i in [q-1,q+t-2]⊆[q-1,p-2], yielding I_p(q)<p-1. CRT intersection shows any alternate period s forces P_0=P_g where g=gcd(s,p); contradiction unless p|s. Finite independent direct-Frobenius verification up to p=60 supports published premise, not infinite assertion.
